title: Nice Umami Jamaican Fish Poke
description: A lazy Sunday Jamaican dish featuring sashimi-cut fish, grapefruit juice, and a creamy umami sauce, perfect for a relaxing meal. This egg-free friendly recipe is easy to make and packed with flavor.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together grapefruit juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, ginger, and garlic to make the umami sauce.
Add the sashimi-cut fish to the bowl and toss to coat with the umami sauce.
Let the fish marinate for at least 30 minutes in the refrigerator.
Just before serving, stir in the chopped scotch bonnet pepper.
In a small bowl, whip the coconut cream until it becomes stiff and holds its shape.
Fold the whipped coconut cream into the fish mixture to add a creamy texture.
Serve the Nice Umami Jamaican Fish Poke immediately, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers promptly and consume within a day.
Before serving, give the fish a good stir and adjust the seasoning if necessary.
